data.content_ref: inline:The claim that the book has exactly 300 pages depends on the formal digit-usage function D(n) = 9·1 + 90·2 + (n−99)·3, which serves as a shared mechanism for segmenting the 792 digits by page-number width; it is refuted if the numeral system is not base-10 positional (e.g., Roman numerals), as the digit-usage function and thus the total page count would differ.
